newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's property shares sub-index soars 3.19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila's property shares sub-index soars 3.19 pct.

text.p: The Philippine's stock market property sub-index climbed 37.50 points, or 3.19 percent, to 1,214.34 in mid-session trading on bargain hunting, brokers said.
"It's bargains galore and all stocks must go," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
"There's some confidence in the general market and part of it is due to the U.S. Fed not changing interest rates," said Ramon Saulo, analyst at Asiamerit Securities.
Index heavyweight Ayala Land Inc rose by 25 centavos, or 1.39 percent, to 18.25 pesos in mid-trade.
Filinvest Land Inc, one of the hardest hit in the recent property scare, climbed 13.10 percent, to 4.75 pesos.
Property issues have been bludgeoned in recent weeks by fears of a meltdown in the real estate sector and concerns over interest rates.
The propoerty index has dropped 31 percent since its peak of 1,748.20 points in February this year.
